Issue Number: close #31868

Problem Summary: 
The `time.sub()` will cause overflow when the gap with duration greatter than 290 years, so use `time.add()` instead of it. Open a new issue to trace improve `time` type https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/32937

issue_context.title: `SUBTIME` function returns wrong result in DATETIME(N) type
comments: The root case is `gotime.Duration` only support about 290 years. If the a within 290 years, the result is correct.

review_comments: It will cause overflow, so use `time.Add` instead of it.
